author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
If you want to experience the China you see in our videos, come travel with us:
https://littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

This week, our road trip took us to the legendary Daocheng Yading area in western Sichuan, a region with deep Tibetan roots and a rich, living Tibetan culture. We crossed mountain passes at nearly 4,700 meters (15,400 ft) and stayed in a hotel at 4,000 meters (13,100 ft). Traveling at those altitudes was exhausting, but we met some amazing people along the way.
